research_rejections.title: CHiPs
research_rejections.reason: Reviews document recurring motorcycle pursuits, shootouts and fights, but also extensive comedy and investigation; the available evidence does not establish sufficiently sustained whole-runtime action density or a complete defensible 33-dimension DNA assessment.

research_rejections.title: The Gorge
research_rejections.reason: Reviews explicitly describe a romance-focused first act followed by an action-heavy second half, so whole-runtime sustained action density is not established.

research_rejections.title: Stormbreaker
research_rejections.reason: Reviews corroborate several chases and practical action sequences, but do not establish sustained whole-runtime action density; critical assessments also note limited suspense and uneven production quality.
